title: mmIR: Frequency-Space Inverse Rendering for 3D Millimeter-Wave Radar ADC Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.28913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution 3D radar data is scarce. Commodity mmWave sensors use small antenna arrays that limit angular resolution to several degrees, and existing datasets provide only 2D range-azimuth maps or sparse point clouds rather than raw analog-to-digital converter (ADC) signals. Hardware scaling is expensive, synthetic-aperture scanning is impractical at fleet scale, and learned synthesis methods are bottlenecked by the very data shortage they aim to address. We present mmIR, an open-source differentiable frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar inverse renderer that fits a physics-based forward model to real captures and re-renders from dense virtual apertures to synthesize high-resolution 3D radar data. Because radar resolution is too coarse to recover geometry directly, mmIR performs LiDAR-assisted inverse rendering: using LiDAR-derived meshes as a geometric scaffold, mmIR optimizes per-vertex International Telecommunication

translated_title: mmIR：面向三维毫米波雷达ADC合成的频率-空间逆渲染
translated_abstract: 高分辨率三维雷达数据十分稀缺。商用毫米波传感器采用小型天线阵列，将角分辨率限制在数度量级，且现有数据集仅提供二维距离-方位图或稀疏点云，而非原始模数转换器（ADC）信号。扩大硬件规模成本高昂，车队规模下的合成孔径扫描也不切实际，而学习式合成方法又受制于其本欲解决的数据匮乏问题本身。我们提出mmIR，一个开源的可微分调频连续波（FMCW）雷达逆渲染器，它将基于物理的前向模型拟合到真实采集数据上，并从密集虚拟孔径重新渲染，以合成高分辨率三维雷达数据。由于雷达分辨率过粗而无法直接恢复几何结构，mmIR采用激光雷达辅助的逆渲染方法：以激光雷达导出的网格作为几何骨架，mmIR优化逐顶点的国际电信（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: mmIR提出一个开源可微分的FMCW雷达逆渲染器，通过将物理前向模型拟合到真实采集数据并以LiDAR网格为几何骨架进行虚拟孔径重渲染，合成高分辨率三维毫米波雷达ADC数据。
en_tdlr: mmIR is an open-source differentiable FMCW radar inverse renderer that fits a physics-based forward model to real captures and re-renders from dense virtual apertures, using LiDAR-assisted inverse rendering to synthesize high-resolution 3D millimeter-wave radar ADC data.
